summary: Computer Technology graduate with 1,800 hours of hands-on IT and administrative support experience gained through an internship at a shipping and logistics company. Background spans manual QA testing of a production biometric attendance system (test case writing and execution, pre-release testing, and bug reporting/tracking in an Agile/Kanban workflow), data entry and technical support/troubleshooting. Also plans, directs, and manually tests personal software projects built with AI-assisted development, tracking work through GitHub Issues and Kanban boards. Detail-oriented, reliable, and quick to learn new systems, with fast and accurate typing (80+ WPM).

coreSkills.items: Manual, Functional & Regression Testing; Test Case Writing & Execution; Release/Pre-Release Testing; Bug Reporting & Tracking; Agile/Kanban Workflows
Basic Hardware/Software Troubleshooting; Hardware & Software Installation; End-User Technical Support; Data Entry
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL; Git & GitHub (incl. Issues, Kanban Boards); VS Code; AI-Assisted Development
Microsoft Excel & Word; Google Sheets & Docs

bullets: Performed manual QA testing for production updates to BITS, a biometric attendance system, by developing and executing test cases, conducting pre-release testing, and reporting and tracking defects across overtime, shift, punch-time, and reporting workflows.
Used Agile/Kanban practices with a GitHub board to track sprint tasks through To Do, In Progress, Testing, and Done stages.
Entered and maintained inventory, administrative, and biometric attendance records, verifying data for errors and inconsistencies before finalization.
Organized and maintained physical and digital records for efficient retrieval while supporting the real-time attendance dashboard and associated system data.
Provided technical and administrative support through basic hardware/software troubleshooting, installation, and configuration for office systems.

projects.name: ArcaneTyper — Multiplayer Typing Game
bullets: Defined project requirements and guided AI-assisted development of a web-based typing game featuring survival, practice, and real-time duel modes, along with leaderboards, achievements, and user accounts.
Manually tested gameplay modes, scoring, and real-time multiplayer interactions; documented bugs and tracked enhancements through GitHub Issues.

projects.name: Mimic — Android Party Game with Private Encrypted Vault
bullets: Defined requirements and guided AI-assisted development of an Android social-deduction game featuring three game modes, five word packs, LAN multiplayer for up to eight players, and a private encrypted vault for photos, videos, and notes.

Manually tested gameplay and vault-security features, including gesture unlock, PIN setup, failed-PIN lockout, auto-lock, and encrypted video playback. Performed additional testing on a physical device running the release build.
Identified release-specific defects, including a vault setup issue on clean installs, and incorporated clean-install testing on a wiped physical device into the release-testing process.

education.credential: Bachelor of Industrial Technology, Major in Computer Technology
